newsitem.title: INDIA: India's United Front expects new leader on Friday.
newsitem.headline: India's United Front expects new leader on Friday.

text.p: India's United Front coalition expects to choose a new leader to replace caretaker Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda at a meeting set for Friday, a spokesman of the 15-party alliance said.
Jaipal Reddy told Reuters that the coalition's Steering Committee would meet on Friday morning to discuss the leadership issue. "Most probably it will arrive at a decision tomorrow," he said.
Earlier on Thursday, Reddy told Reuters by telephone that the Steering Committee would not decide on a new leader at a meeting set for Thursday at 3 p.m. (0930 GMT).
At Thursday's meeting, the committee will pass a resolution honouring the memory of veteran politician Biju Patnaik, who died in a New Delhi hospital on Thursday morning, Reddy said.
"It will transact essential business without taking a decision (on leadership)," he said.

The United Front spokesman acknowledged that a decision would be delayed in part because of a demand by leftwing parties that the Congress party first withdraw a letter to President Shankar Dayal Sharma staking a claim to power, as well as jockeying among contenders to succeed Deve Gowda.
